package store

import "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"

// AllQueries hands back a slice of *Queries. returnsQueriesType, before this round, only ever
// unwrapped one *ast.StarExpr looking for a bare Queries identifier, so a slice element type
// buried one level deeper went unnoticed.
func AllQueries(pool *pgxpool.Pool) []*Queries {
	return []*Queries{{pool: pool, scopes: Scopes{"personal", "work", "client-globex"}}}
}
